prompt:
Create one finished native editable SVG sheet for Emberwake, an original dark-fantasy action RPG. Two enemies, FOUR genuine diagonal turnarounds each. Sculptural painted cut-paper fantasy, expressive continuous anatomy, broad light/middle/shadow planes, selective engraved cuts. Work as a character designer, not an icon factory. Figures must read beautifully at 30-40 pixels. No photoreal PBR, plastic gloss, dense hatching or repeating noise.

EXACT SHEET: 1536x768 viewBox="0 0 1536 768". Eight square 384x384 screen-aligned cells. Row 1 Ash hound; row 2 Cinder acolyte. Columns in order SE, SW, NE, NW. Name eight separate top-level groups hound-se, hound-sw, hound-ne, hound-nw, cultist-se, cultist-sw, cultist-ne, cultist-nw. Each group's coordinates are LOCAL to its cell; only its outer group has the translation (column*384,row*384). Keep all art inside its cell with at least 25px transparent margin. No sheet background, terrain, floor tile, pedestal, cast/contact shadow, visible text, arrows, grid, border, watermark or VFX. Deliver vector paths and simple shapes, no embedded raster/scripts/external resources. Use explicit fill colors; no gradients/IDs for paint resources, no use elements. The group names are the only IDs.

CAMERA: fixed mildly elevated orthographic view, looking down 27 degrees. These are square-screen tactical figures, NOT diamond isometric terrain. SE faces lower-right: face and chest front-quarter visible. SW faces lower-left: OTHER front-quarter. NE faces upper-right: rear-quarter, spine/back and rear of head dominate, muzzle peeks beyond far shoulder. NW faces upper-left: OTHER rear-quarter. Do not flip a front view to fake a rear view. No whole-sheet or whole-character mirroring; redraw overlaps, foreshortening, gear placement, and lighting for every view. A single common upper-left light in SCREEN space makes upper-left planes pale and lower-right planes dark in EVERY cell, including opposite headings. No lighting flips. Same individual, same anatomy, proportions, garment and equipment across all four headings. Not four alternate creatures. Establish coherent feet on a common virtual ground plane, though no ground is drawn. Camera elevation and figure scale are identical across cells.

ASH HOUND, exact monster ID hound, row 1: lean ash-russet living quadruped. Forward tracking head, high withers, powerful narrow shoulders flowing into low compact haunches, tucked abdomen. Continuous skull-neck-shoulder-spine-pelvis gesture, connected elbows/wrists/hocks and four weighted paws with useful negative spaces. Ragged CHARCOAL mane grows from nape and upper shoulder, 3-5 major tufts rather than spikes everywhere. Long tapered muzzle with a SMALL ivory lower jaw accent, recessed dark eye, animal ears attached to skull. One ear nick and a pale asymmetric cheek scar identify the same animal around the turn. Sinewy russet body, charcoal lower legs, narrow tail tapering behind and down. Alert forward lean, all limbs supported rather than running or floating. Physical melee; NO flame, glow, armor, harness, horns, extra legs, saber fangs or monstrous giant skull. Palette ash russet #ab7860, warm highlight #d9a17f, mid #93624e, shadow #4b3936, charcoal #272a30, ivory #e5d5af. Hound target visible bounds about 300x240 inside each 384 square, leaving air above its low body. At sheet scaled by 0.1 each hound should occupy approximately 30x24px, not a 50px illustration pretending to be a minion. Make shoulder/muzzle/mane the three main readable signals. Rear views clearly show withers, rump, tail root and far tracking head; do not paint a face on the back.

CINDER ACOLYTE, exact monster ID cultist, row 2: dusty wine/salmon hooded figure, slightly bowed head and forward intent, asymmetric sleeves, bent dark wooden staff held close to the body by the SAME anatomical RIGHT hand in every view. The left hand cups one small warm ember by the ribs. Ember is a compact ochre/orange solid accent, no halo, sparks, trail or glow spilling outside silhouette. Staff has one bent crook and a bound ivory collar, no giant orb. Recessed ASH face within hood, small slanted cheek planes rather than a black faceless hole. Hood flows into shoulder mantle; cloth weight hangs from the shoulders, bent elbows connect to wrists, belt compresses robe at waist, split irregular hem reveals two planted soot-dark boots. One narrow ivory stitch panel runs down the LEFT shoulder, visible only when the body turn permits it; it must never switch anatomical sides. One longer sleeve, one close-fitting sleeve. Design actual folds with a few broad overlapping shapes, quiet torso, 2-3 decisive edge cuts. Palette wine #753f49, dusty salmon #b3726b, high lit cloth #d99886, deep fold #432d39, ash face #a6a09a, staff #604b3f, ember #efb56c. Visible bounds about 280-300x330 inside each cell (about 30x33px when reduced by 0.1). Boots meet the ground at a consistent y near 350. Rear-quarter views show hood back, mantle overlap, spine folds and staff grip/placement, NO ash face drawn through the hood. No staff change, horned helmet, enlarged head, fire wings, long spell trails or weapon substitutions.

Three clear value groups before fine accents; contour hierarchy, connected living forms and honest rear views are paramount. Simplify tiny anatomy into confident curved planes, not geometric sausages, disconnected polygon legs or toy silhouettes. The eight cells must be independently extractable as complete transparent standalone SVG figures and compared at actual field scale. This is a static directional character study, not walk animation. Do not add extra frames or story elements.
